people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
translations.bsb: Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
translations.kjv: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
translations.asv: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
